summary: Frontend-only verification of Profile cog + Paywall + PRO gating. PASS: settings-cog-button in Profile header opens the settings sheet (testID settings-card) containing notifications-switch, focus-lock-switch, manage-pro-button ('Upgrade' pre-purchase), settings-close-button. Old inline Settings section is gone from the scroll page (settings-card only renders inside the Modal). Paywall route /paywall renders paywall-screen with hero, 3 perks, paywall-buy-button, paywall-restore-button, paywall-close. Console: NO 'RevenueCat public API keys not found' error; '[RevenueCat] identity bound: ui-test-user' log confirmed (not $RCAnonymousID). No leaderboard-pro-badge on non-subscribed user (correct). Garden/Goals/Focus/Friends/Profile tabs all render. Timer tab shows focus-lock-banner. Code inspection: ads.web.ts is a no-op (isLoaded=false, preload/showIfReady are stubs); timer.tsx only calls showIfReady() after `if (!isSubscribed)` and passes `!isSubscribed` into useCompletionInterstitial + calls preload() at session start. TWO BLOCKING BUGS FOUND — see backend_issues (actually paywall/RC) below: (1) paywall-buy-button shows '$9.99/month' — NOT '$2.99/month' as the user explicitly said to report; (2) identityReady stays false on the paywall even 20s+ after Purchases.logIn logs 'identity bound: ui-test-user', so the buy button is aria-disabled and 'Syncing your account… hold on a second.' warning persists — the RevenueCat Test Store purchase cannot be triggered from the web preview. Because of #2 the entitlement flip → paywall-active → PRO settings label → golden leaderboard-pro-badge chain COULD NOT be exercised end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: paywall-buy-button reads 'Go ad-free — $9.99/month'. Expected '$2.99/month' per /app/memory/revenuecat.md ($rc_monthly -> prodd15c4e46b9, $2.99 P1M). The RC Test Store offering being returned to the web SDK still carries the old $9.99 price — either the reprice on $rc_monthly did not propagate to the RC Test Store product, or the offerings query cache is stale. Confirmed via inner_text() from paywall-buy-button after full boot + Profile>Upgrade path. Reference: paywall.tsx:97 (price string comes from offerings.current.availablePackages).

identityReady stays FALSE on the paywall (aria-disabled=true on paywall-buy-button, 'Syncing your account… hold on a second.' visible) even 15–20s AFTER _layout.tsx logs '[RevenueCat] identity bound: ui-test-user'. Root cause (very likely): after Purchases.logIn(user.user_id) resolves in _layout.tsx (line 62), the react-query cache key ['revenuecat','customer-info'] is NOT invalidated, so customerInfoQuery.data.originalAppUserId keeps the pre-login '$RCAnonymousID:…' value and the paywall's derived identityReady flag stays false forever. The addCustomerInfoUpdateListener listener does exist in revenuecat.tsx:48-56 but is not firing in the web SDK on logIn. Fix: after Purchases.logIn resolves in _layout.tsx, call queryClient.setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], customerInfo) (or invalidateQueries) so the paywall picks up the bound identity. Reference: _layout.tsx:57-73, revenuecat.tsx:74-75. IMPACT: purchase cannot be initiated in the web preview at all, so the whole PRO chain (paywall-active, manage-pro-button 'PRO' label, leaderboard-pro-badge) could not be verified end-to-end.

integration_issues.flow: Paywall purchase (RevenueCat Test Store, Browser Mode)
integration_issues.issue: Blocked by identityReady=false — buy is disabled, so we cannot exercise the Test Store checkout. Once bug 2 is fixed, please re-run and verify paywall-confirm-modal → paywall-confirm-button → paywall-active, then reopen settings sheet (manage-pro-button text should flip to 'PRO') and Friends tab (leaderboard-pro-badge should appear on the ui-test-user row only).

action_items: FIX #1 (pricing): The RC Test Store $rc_monthly product still returns $9.99 to the web SDK. Re-run the RevenueCat integration proxy repricing call (POST /internal/revenuecat/.../products with amount_micros=2990000, currency USD, period P1M) and confirm getOfferings() returns $2.99 for $rc_monthly. This is what the user explicitly asked to report.

FIX #2 (identity ready in web): After `await Purchases.logIn(user.user_id)` in app/_layout.tsx AuthGate, sync the react-query cache so the paywall's identityReady flag flips to true. Simplest fix — inject queryClient via useQueryClient() in AuthGate and call queryClient.setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], customerInfo) with the logIn result, and/or queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['revenuecat','customer-info'] }). Without this the buy button stays disabled in the web preview forever.

AFTER both fixes: re-run the RC Test Store purchase in web (Browser Mode) end-to-end to verify entitlement flip → paywall-active, settings sheet 'Upgrade' → 'PRO', and Friends leaderboard golden badge (testID leaderboard-pro-badge) shows on the ui-test-user row.
critical_code_review_comments: revenuecat.tsx:15-23 — getRevenueCatApiKey() throws when any of the 3 keys is missing, but initializeRevenueCat() at module scope is wrapped in try/catch in _layout.tsx, so a missing key becomes a silent 'RevenueCat unavailable:' warn. That is fine, but a missing key should also disable the paywall route (currently the paywall would render with no offerings and show 'Subscription options are unavailable right now.').

revenuecat.tsx:74-75 — identityReady is derived from customerInfoQuery.data.originalAppUserId, which is fetched ONCE (staleTime 60s) and only refreshed by the customerInfoUpdateListener. On web the listener does not seem to fire after Purchases.logIn, leaving identityReady=false. Consider explicitly syncing after logIn (see action item #2).

paywall.tsx:26-28 — falling back to `availablePackages[0]` when $rc_monthly is missing is fine, but you may want to log/telemetry when the fallback triggers, since it could quietly bill users the wrong price.

timer.tsx:37 — useCompletionInterstitial is called on every render; on web this is the no-op hook so cheap. On native it is fine because useInterstitialAd handles remounts, but consider passing a stable `enabled` boolean (already done via !isSubscribed).

success_rate.frontend: 60% (settings cog + tabs + regression PASS; paywall pricing + identityReady BLOCKED, purchase chain not exercised)

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (pricing): getOfferings() returns $9.99 for $rc_monthly — either the RC Test Store product wasn't repriced or the CDN cache is stale. User reported repricing $rc_monthly to $2.99 but the web SDK's offerings still show $9.99. Bug 2 (identityReady stuck false): _layout.tsx calls Purchases.logIn() and logs the bound customerInfo, but revenuecat.tsx's customerInfoQuery cache is never updated with that result. The addCustomerInfoUpdateListener is registered but is not firing after logIn on the web SDK (react-native-purchases-js 1.52.3). Because identityReady is derived purely from that cached customerInfo.originalAppUserId, it remains '$RCAnonymousID:*' and the paywall keeps the buy button disabled. Reproduction: boot app with uitest_token_123 → open /paywall → observe 'Syncing your account… hold on a second.' warning persists indefinitely and aria-disabled=true on paywall-buy-button.
